resources.string: Keeps your selected media app going through brief ignition-mode pauses.
Only act while Android Auto is connected
Only act after a phone charging-power change (safer, but may miss the pause)
Pause media when Android Auto disconnects

Enabled by default: when Android Auto disconnects, DrivePlay Keeper pauses the selected media app, cancels any pending resume, and leaves it paused until playback is started again. Turn this off if it does not suit your setup.
A quick second Pause after an automatic resume is always respected. Playback ending or the selected media app stopping is never restarted.
Open Battery, then select Unrestricted or Allow background usage. Also remove DrivePlay Keeper from Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps if your phone offers those options.

After the selected media app has played for the configured arm time, DrivePlay Keeper treats the next Pause as the car’s ignition pause and sends Play once after the configured delay. A second Pause within the configured manual-pause window is treated as intentional. Protection resets when playback is deliberately started again.\n\nKeep “Only act while Android Auto is connected” enabled for normal use. Try the power-change option only if the phone briefly stops or starts charging when the engine starts.
